title: The Blue Book briefing folders of 160 remote viewing successes

tellings.quote: we had What's called the Blue Book the blue briefing books it was two books two folders with 160 successes in it

plain: The US Army's remote viewing unit at Fort Meade, Maryland, which trained people to describe distant targets by mind alone, is said to have kept what it called "the Blue Book": two blue briefing folders holding 160 successes, used from about 1978 into the 1990s. Joe McMoneagle, who served in the unit, tells Michels this himself. If true, the unit kept a written record of 160 times the method worked, ready to show officials.
